# Sidebar Instructions

## Approved Behavior

- The sidebar background is `#000000`.
- It is expanded by default.
- It contains only the Dashboard navigation item.
- It includes a collapse/expand affordance based on the uploaded small arrow reference image.
- The filter panel attaches immediately to the right side of the sidebar when Dashboard is active.

## Styling Expectations

- Keep the sidebar narrow and utilitarian.
- Use a recognizable dashboard icon with text when expanded.
- When collapsed, retain enough visual signal to understand the Dashboard section is active.
- Do not add the extra navigation items from the reference screenshot.
